facts.site: Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop
facts.title: loss of containment at MAG-9602 during routine operation

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was medical treatment injury, with 1 person injured.

defences.finding: Control ENERGY_SOURCE_IDENTIFICATION: the identification of every energy source for the task was in place but did not perform, and the root cause analysis classified this as an organisational factor.

Control ISOLATION_HANDBACK_CONTROL: the controlled removal of isolation and return to service was in place but did not perform, and the root cause analysis classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control POSITIVE_ISOLATION_APPLICATION: the application of positive isolation devices and personal locks was in place but did not perform, and the root cause analysis classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control STORED_ENERGY_DISSIPATION: the dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy was in place but did not perform, and the root cause analysis classified this as an individual or team action.
Control ZERO_ENERGY_VERIFICATION: the proving zero energy before intrusive work had been bypassed, and the root cause analysis classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the controlled removal of isolation and return to service on MAG-9602 and record the field verification before this task is next authorised.
Restore the application of positive isolation devices and personal locks on MAG-9602 and record the field verification before this task is next authorised.
Restore the proving zero energy before intrusive work on MAG-9602 and record the field verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in restoring plant to service, specifically removing isolation and returning to operations. MAG-9602 (explosives magazines) is in service for explosives and detonator storage. The task proceeded during routine operation while the identification of every energy source for the task was in place but did not perform. The thermal energy involved is held as hot surface, and the recorded presentation was burn, ignition, scald.
response.summary: On 31 March 2011 an incident occurred on MAG-9602 at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop during routine operation, releasing thermal energy held as hot surface.
